newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Andalusia auctions 10.2 bln pesetas bonds.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Andalusia auctions 10.2 bln pesetas bonds.

text.p: Spain's Andalusia regional government (Junta de Andalucia) allotted on Thursday in a public auction a total of 10.2 billion pesetas in three-, five- and 10-year bonds, the regional government said FRRD.
The allocation took place with a slight increase in yields compared with the previous auction in February.
ISSUE YIELD PVS PRICE PVS BID ALLOCATION
NOTE - All are tranches of old bonds. The previous auction was held on February 6.
Moody's long term debt rating for Junta de Andalucia is Aa3. At the end of September 1996 the region's total debt was 767 billion pesetas of which 268 billion pesetas was in bonds.
